colours.name: Snowy Mountains Half
colours.description: Snowy Mountains Half is a slightly neutral white that can be used with warmer and cooler colours. It can easily be used for the main colour both inside and out.

colours.name: Natural White™
colours.description: Natural White™ is the lightest of warm whites and also one of our most popular. Loved by home renovators and interior designers alike, this versatile white will brighten any space. It is perfect for main walls inside and out and ideal for exterior features. It never fails to impress.

colours.name: Lexicon®
colours.description: Give your home a smart, modern look with the crisp white of Lexicon®. The fresh feel with a slightly bluish undertone brings textures and cooler coloured furnishings into play and highlights vibrant accessories in your space. Lexicon® is great for light reflectance and the perfect cooler white to use for a bright well-lit interior, for all main walls or trims and architraves. It is also perfect for exterior walls and features such as windows and trims.

colours.name: Light Rice Quarter
colours.description: Light Rice Quarter is a soft neutral that can be used in both traditional and contemporary homes and brings a lovely warmth to the space.

colours.name: Light Rice
colours.description: Light Rice is a soft neutral with a red undertone. This versatile colour can be used in both traditional and contemporary homes and brings a lovely warmth to the space. It pairs well with the lush warm ivory of Whisper White.

colours.name: Mellow Beige Quarter
colours.description: Browns are a beautiful earthy grounding colour. They vary in tone and shade and can be dark or light. Lighter versions of brown include beige, tans, toffee or taupe. Browns can achieve a feeling of safety and security in your home.

colours.name: Mellow Beige Half
colours.description: Browns are a beautiful earthy grounding colour. They vary in tone and shade and can be dark or light. Lighter versions of brown include beige, tans, toffee or taupe. Browns can achieve a feeling of safety and security in your home.

colours.name: Vintage Beige
colours.description: A warm midtone neutral with ochre undertone, Vintage Beige is great as main wall or trim colour inside and outside.

colours.name: Terrace White
colours.description: With a hint of a grey-beige undertone, Terrace White is ideal for pairing with cooler whites and muted shades. It is perfect for interior or exterior walls and trims. Terrace White schemes beautifully with Lexicon® Half or Tranquil Retreat.

colours.name: Tapestry Beige
colours.description: A rich neutral with a warm undertone, Tapestry Beige can be used as a main wall colour or trim inside and out. Pairs well with warm whites.

colours.name: Swamp Fox
colours.description: Yellows are vibrant and reflective and can create a happy and bright environment. Yellow is warm and is perfectly suited for south-facing spaces. Yellows can be used in casual living areas, hallways and entry spaces to create a light-filled bright setting.

colours.name: White Duck Quarter
colours.description: White Duck Quarter is a soft warm neutral with a slightly green undertone. It can be used in any interior space or as a main or trim colour on exteriors and pairs well with neutrals such as Oyster Linen and Linseed.

colours.name: Winter Fog
colours.description: Winter Fog is a slightly warm greige with depth, it's lovely as a main wall colour both inside and outside the home. It pairs well with deep charcoals such as Double Bass and Klavier.

colours.name: Handmade Linen Half
colours.description: Handmade Linen Half is a warm creamy neutral with yellow and green undertones. It's a great choice if you are looking to add warmth and brightness to a room.  Pair it with warm whites such as Natural White™ or rich warm browns such as Empty Stage.

colours.name: Blind Date
colours.description: Blind Date is a soft warm neutral with a red undertone that can be used as a main colour or feature colour both inside and out. Pair it with crisp whites to create an aura of elegance.

colours.name: Beige Royal
colours.description: A sophisticated and timeless warm neutral, Beige Royal can be used throughout modern and traditional homes to add warmth and subtle colour. It can create a rich, stylish exterior and is ideal for creating a layering effect by pairing with other neutral warm whites such as Natural White™.

colours.name: Beige Antiquity
colours.description: Beige Antiquity is a warm neutral with a red undertone that can be used as a main wall colour inside and out. This colour schemes well with neutral whites.

colours.name: Grand Piano
colours.description: Grand Piano is an elegant warm neutral. This dynamic colour suits both traditional and contemporary homes and can be used as an interior colour throughout the house or on the exterior of the home.

colours.name: Ecru
colours.description: Ecru is a lovely warm neutral with a soft greenish undertone that is perfect for interior main walls or exteriors.

colours.name: Antique White U.S.A.®
colours.description: Classic and inviting, Antique White U.S.A.® is a perennial favourite. Its beautiful warmth allows artworks and colour details to sing. A versatile white that suits any space, indoors or out including interior walls, weatherboards, render and trim. It schemes well with the crisp Vivid White™.

colours.name: Puppy
colours.description: Puppy is a warm neutral with a tan base that can be used extensively inside and out. It pairs well with a warm white such as Natural White™ or Antique White U.S.A.®

colours.name: Buff It
colours.description: Buff It is a soft, warm neutral with a slightly beige undertone and perfect to warm up your interior or exterior. This welcoming colour works well with other soft neutrals and the light warmth of Natural White™.

colours.name: Balsa Stone
colours.description: Balsa Stone is a warm neutral with a lovely green undertone that is perfect for interiors and exteriors in both accents or main walls.

colours.name: Antique
colours.description: Neutrals are a beautiful grounding colour. They vary in tone and shade and can be dark or light.  These versatile colours are warm and inviting and work well both inside and outside the home.

colours.name: Winter Terrace
colours.description: Winter Terrace is a warm greige with a subtle greenish undertone that creates an inviting look for both interiors and exteriors.

colours.name: Casper White Quarter
colours.description: A slightly warmer white, Casper White Quarter is a great neutral white that can be used as a main wall colour, trim or an exterior colour. This soft and flexible white works well with many colours including bold dark and lighter shades.

colours.name: Ecru Quarter
colours.description: Ecru Quarter is a warm white with ivory undertones. The soft and light colour can easily transform any space and provides the flexibility to personalise your home with layers of other complementary shades or accent colours. It is an excellent base for many interior styles.

colours.name: White Polar Quarter
colours.description: White Polar Quarter is such a neutral white that it works well with both cooler and warmer neutrals and many other colours throughout your home. It works well as a trim colour outside or as the main render or weatherboard colour if you're looking for that bright white.

colours.name: White on White™
colours.description: White on White™ is a clean, minimalist white that brings a sense of energy and vitality to your home. This cool white with a slightly cool blue undertone is perfect for a bright space in a contemporary setting.

colours.name: Hog Bristle®
colours.description: Hog Bristle® is a versatile warm neutral that can be used throughout the home and works wonderfully on exteriors. It looks great when matched with the warmth of Antique White U.S.A.®, soft neutral of Hog Bristle® Half or vibrant fun of Red Box.

colours.name: Handmade Linen
colours.description: Yellows are vibrant and reflective and can create a happy and bright environment. Yellow is warm and is perfectly suited for south-facing spaces. Yellows can be used in casual living areas, hallways and entry spaces to create a light-filled bright setting.

colours.name: Grand Piano Quarter
colours.description: Grand Piano Quarter is a soft warm neutral with a subtle red undertone. It is great as a main wall colour both inside and outside the home or can be used as a trim colour.

colours.name: Grand Piano Half
colours.description: The beautiful soft neutral of Grand Piano Half is a versatile shade that can be used as a main colour anywhere throughout the house.

colours.name: Berkshire White
colours.description: Berkshire White is a creamy warm white that adds warmth to a space and can be used as a main wall colour throughout the home. It works well with warm whites and neutrals.

colours.name: Beige Intent
colours.description: Luminous, fresh, natural and light are just a few of the qualities of the Dulux Most Loved Whites and Neutrals collection. The right shade can easily transform any space, from clean and crisp to warm and inviting. The Whites and Neutrals range provides the flexibility to personalise your home with layers of other complementary shades or accent colours. These whites and neutrals are an excellent base for many interior styles.

colours.name: White Beach Quarter
colours.description: White Beach Quarter is a light and reflective neutral white that can be used for main walls and trims both inside and out.  It's warm and inviting tone can easily transform any space.

colours.name: Vivid White™
colours.description: Vivid White™ is a pure clean white that is perfect for creating a clean, contemporary look. It is the ultimate choice for modern interior walls and trims and is also ideal for exterior features such as fretwork and window frames. The crisp freshness of Vivid White™ will brighten any space and give it a luxe modern vibe.

colours.name: White Exchange Half
colours.description: White Exchange Half is a lovely warm white with a subtle beige undertone perfect for main walls on interiors and exteriors. It schemes beautifully with the coolness of Lexicon® Quarter inside while externally it pairs well with darker blues and greys.

colours.name: White Duck Half
colours.description: White Duck Half is a light and neutral white with a subtle green undertone that is perfect for main walls inside and out.

colours.name: White Duck
colours.description: White Duck is a soft neutral with a slightly green undertone that is suited to main walls or accents both inside and out.

colours.name: Stowe White
colours.description: Stowe White is a creamy white with a yellowish undertone perfect to warm up a space both inside and out.

colours.name: Sandy Day
colours.description: Sandy Day is a beautiful natural beige for a warm main wall or accent colour. It schemes perfectly with Natural White™ for both interiors and exteriors. Scheme using Warm Whites such as Natural White™ and a deeper blue such as Snap-Shot.

colours.name: Silver Tea Set
colours.description: The beautiful, soft silver-grey of Silver Tea Set is slightly on the warmer side and perfect for interior walls to create a subtle Hamptons look. It is also a great main wall or trim colour for exteriors. For contrast, Silver Tea Set pairs well with dark charcoals such as Namadji®.

colours.name: Seed Pearl
colours.description: Seed Pearl is a creamy, warm soft white that looks stunning on both the inside and outside of traditional homes.

colours.name: Oyster Linen
colours.description: Oyster Linen is a midtone warm neutral with a greenish undertone that can be used inside or out as trim or main colour. It pairs well with neutral whites.

colours.name: Limed White Quarter
colours.description: The warm subtle neutral of Limed White Quarter is perfect for both interiors and exteriors as a main wall colour. It pairs well with neutrals such as Limed White, Light Leather and Tapestry Beige as well as muted browns such as Tree Hollow.

colours.name: Light Rice Half
colours.description: Light Rice Half is a soft neutral with a red undertone. This versatile colour can be used in both traditional and contemporary homes and brings a lovely warmth to the space. It pairs well with the creamy yellow of Jodhpurs.

colours.name: Light Leather
colours.description: Light Leather is a deeper neutral with a warm undertone. It can be used as a feature or main wall colour inside or out.

colours.name: Lexicon® Half
colours.description: For a crisp, modern look Lexicon® Half is a perfect clean white suitable for trims or main walls for both inside and out. It is a great white for highlighting exterior features or if you're looking for a bright white for walls. Lexicon® Half pairs well with neutrals, cool greys and charcoals such as Candle Bark, Colorbond® Woodland Grey®, Dieskau, Highgate, Miller Mood, Milton Moon, Oolong, Silkwort, Stepney and Terrace White.

colours.name: Linseed
colours.description: The graceful midtone neutral of Linseed is a beautiful colour to add to any space inside or outside the home. It pairs well with the warmth of White Duck Quarter and the dark charcoal of Colorbond® Monument®.

colours.name: Limed White Half
colours.description: The warm subtle neutral of Limed White Half is perfect for both interiors and exteriors as a main wall colour. It pairs well with neutrals such as Limed White, Light Leather and Tapestry Beige as well as muted browns such as Tree Hollow.

colours.name: Limed White
colours.description: Limed White is a warm, muted neutral with a red undertone that is great for main walls and trims inside or out. It pairs beautifully with the low-key purple of Private Tone and cool White on White™.

colours.name: Lexicon® Quarter
colours.description: A cool fresh white, Lexicon® Quarter is the perfect choice for the walls and trim of modern, open-plan spaces. Create a vibrant mood that allows you to showcase eclectic artworks and furnishings. Lexicon® Quarter is also a great colour to highlight key exterior features or if you're looking for a bright white on the outside of your home. It pairs well with soft greys and neutrals, cool greys, and warm whites and grieges such as Highgate, Winter Terrace, Tranquil Retreat and White Exchange Half.

colours.name: Mellow Beige
colours.description: Luminous, fresh, natural and light are just a few of the qualities from the Dulux® Whites and Neutrals that are Australia’s most loved colours. The right shade can easily transform any space, from clean and crisp to warm and inviting. The Whites and Neutrals range provides the flexibility to personalise your home with layers of other complementary shades or accent colours. These whites and neutrals are an excellent base for many interior styles.

colours.name: Owl Wing
colours.description: Owl Wing is a warm midtone neutral with an ochre-green undertone. It is great as a main wall colour inside and out and pairs well with neutral and warm Whites.

colours.name: White Dune Half
colours.description: White Dune Half is a versatile, warm white that suits traditional and modern aesthetics.  This white pairs well with most colours that have a warm undertone allowing you to create a clean, vibrant look. It is ideal for main walls throughout your home and perfect as a trim colour on the outside.

colours.name: White Cloak Quarter
colours.description: The perfect broad wall colour, White Cloak Quarter strikes a balance between richness and light. Create warm, bright spaces with this versatile colour that suits both classic and contemporary homes inside and out. It is a great starting point for any painting project and complements most warm colours.

colours.name: Whisper White
colours.description: Whisper White lets you create a welcoming atmosphere in your home. As the most perfect ivory, it is a lush, warm white that works beautifully with most colour schemes inside and out in any style of home. Whisper White works well with warm neutrals such as Feather Soft and Sandy Day.

colours.name: Tuft
colours.description: Tuft is a warm neutral that is light with a subtle tan undertone making it perfect for interior and exterior main walls. It pairs well with muted browns such as Tree Hollow and warm neutrals such as Buff It Quarter.

colours.name: White Swan
colours.description: A warm white with a yellowish undertone, White Swan is perfect for open plan interiors and broad walls outside. It pairs well with the warmth of creamy Berkshire White and neutral Owl Wing.

colours.name: Hog Bristle® Quarter
colours.description: There’s something wonderfully warm and welcoming about Hog Bristle® Quarter. This neutral white looks great in traditional and classic-style homes, bringing a lovely, sophisticated ambiance to any room in your home. It is perfect for exterior surfaces such as weatherboards.

colours.name: Highgate
colours.description: Highgate is a subtle cool grey with a slightly greenish undertone that is a perfect neutral for main walls and trim throughout contemporary homes. The softness of Highgate pairs well with a crisp white such as Lexicon® Quarter and greys/grieges such as Signature, Flooded Gum, Raku and Dieskau.

colours.name: Hog Bristle® Half
colours.description: Create warm, inviting spaces with Hog Bristle® Half. This soft neutral transforms any room in the house into a cosy and comfortable living space. Its natural undertones make it the perfect match for warm whites, warm neutrals, reds and browns.

colours.name: Handmade Linen Quarter
colours.description: The neutral Handmade Line Quarter is a beautiful base and sets the scene for striking accents to warmer neutrals.

colours.name: Grey Port
colours.description: Grey Port is a warm greyed-off midtone neutral with a slightly green undertone. It is ideal as a main wall colour inside and out.

colours.name: Snow Season
colours.description: Snow Season is a cooler light grey that is perfect for main walls throughout the home and for the exterior. It schemes beautifully with cool whites such as Lexicon® Quarter or Pewter Frame for more of a contrasting scheme.

colours.name: Feather Soft
colours.description: A much-loved soft neutral greige, Feather Soft is a muted warm hue that brings a sense of simplicity and serenity to the home. Feather Soft's timeless quality means it works well with most neutral and cool whites throughout the home.

colours.name: Ecru Half
colours.description: Ecru Half is a warm white with ivory undertones. The natural warm and inviting colour can easily transform any space and provides the flexibility to personalise your home with layers of other complementary shades or accent colours. It is an excellent base for many interior styles.

colours.name: China White
colours.description: China White is a versatile warm white that can be used in both modern and traditional homes. It is a great colour choice for interiors and exteriors.

colours.name: Chalk U.S.A.
colours.description: Chalk U.S.A. is a warm white with a yellow undertone, perfect as a main interior or exterior colour of a traditional home. It is a great match with the warm neutral of Ecru and rich red of Belly Fire.

colours.name: Buff It Quarter
colours.description: Buff It Quarter is a soft, warm neutral with a slightly beige undertone and perfect to warm up your interior or exterior. This welcoming colour works well with other soft neutrals including the full-strength Buff It and the light warmth of Natural White™.

colours.name: Buff It Half
colours.description: Buff It Half is a soft, warm neutral with a slightly beige undertone and perfect to warm up your interior or exterior. This welcoming colour works well with other soft neutrals including the full-strength Buff It and the light warmth of Natural White™.

colours.name: Beige Royal Quarter
colours.description: Elevate both contemporary and classic spaces with this versatile, soft warm neutral. Beige Royal Quarter is a clean, classic shade that provides a calming backdrop for modern living. This neutral is perfect for walls, window frames and trims inside and out. Complement Beige Royal Quarter with the neutral Natural White™, ultra-pure Vivid White™ or darker warm neutrals such as Light Leather.

colours.name: Beige Royal Half
colours.description: Beige Royal Half is a versatile soft warm neutral that is great as a main wall colour inside and out. It pairs well with both warm and neutral whites.

colours.name: Beige Calm
colours.description: Beige Calm is a soft warm neutral with a red undertone and is perfect for a main colour inside and out.

colours.name: Warm Neutral
colours.description: Warm Neutral is a warm beige with a slightly brownish undertone that is perfect for adding depth to the interior and exteiror walls. It pairs well with soft neutrals such as Light Rice Half.

colours.name: Hardened Steel
colours.description: The versatility and often chameleon-like qualities of grey make it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Grey Master
colours.description: Grey Master is a deep charcoal that can add charm and character to a space. It is great for feature and main walls, as an accent colour or even a front door. This beautiful warm grey pairs well with soft warm greys inside and out.

colours.name: Grey Cabin
colours.description: The versatility and often chameleon-like qualities of grey make it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Outback View
colours.description: Yellows are vibrant and reflective and can create a happy and bright environment. Yellow is warm and is perfectly suited for south-facing spaces. Yellows can be used in casual living areas, hallways and entry spaces to create a light-filled bright setting.

colours.name: Dark Metal
colours.description: The versatility and often chameleon-like qualities of grey make it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Ancient Ruin
colours.description: Ancient Ruin is perfect for accentuating the coastal warmth of the Hamptons look. This popular neutral can create an inviting feel throughout your home inside and is a great main wall colour outside.

colours.name: Jarrah
colours.description: Jarrah is a warm brown with a green undertone that is ideal for highlighting exterior features. It is fantastic when paired with soft beige colours.

colours.name: Irrigation
colours.description: Neutrals are a beautiful grounding colour. They vary in tone and shade and can be dark or light.  These versatile colours are warm and inviting and work well both inside and outside the home.

colours.name: Bronze Fig
colours.description: Bronze Fig is a muted deep green with a brown undertone. It is ideal for feature walls inside and out as well as exterior trims. It pairs well with the crisp Vivid White™ and warm neutrals such as Buff It.

colours.name: Braid
colours.description: Braid is a warm, deep brown with a red undertone that can be used as an accent colour on the inside or outside. It pairs well with warm neutrals such as Beige Royal and whites like Whisper White.

colours.name: Bedbox
colours.description: Browns are a beautiful earthy grounding colour. They vary in tone and shade and can be dark or light. Lighter versions of brown include beige, tans, toffee or taupe. Browns can achieve a feeling of safety and security in your home.

colours.name: Sea Elephant
colours.description: Sea Elephant is a warm brown with red undertones. It can be used as a feature wall colour on the inside or main colour wall on the outside. It pairs well with neutrals and warm whites.

colours.name: Knapsack
colours.description: Neutrals are a beautiful grounding colour. They vary in tone and shade and can be dark or light.  These versatile colours are warm and inviting and work well both inside and outside the home.

colours.name: Osso Bucco
colours.description: Yellows are vibrant and reflective and can create a happy and bright environment. Yellow is warm and is perfectly suited for south-facing spaces. Yellows can be used in casual living areas, hallways and entry spaces to create a light-filled bright setting.

colours.name: Old Ruin
colours.description: Yellows are vibrant and reflective and can create a happy and bright environment. Yellow is warm and is perfectly suited for south-facing spaces. Yellows can be used in casual living areas, hallways and entry spaces to create a light-filled bright setting.

colours.name: Toffee Fingers
colours.description: Toffee Fingers is a midtone warm tan that is great for walls inside and out. It pairs beautifully with Antique White U.S.A.®, Natural White™ and other warm whites.

colours.name: Harold
colours.description: Neutrals are a beautiful grounding colour. They vary in tone and shade and can be dark or light.  These versatile colours are warm and inviting and work well both inside and outside the home.

colours.name: Hammer Grey
colours.description: Hammer Grey is a deep, neutral grey that works beautifully as an interior feature wall or behind shelving or simply to highlight your favourite artwork.  This colour works well with Sandy Day and Terrace White.

colours.name: Stonecrop
colours.description: Stonecrop is a midtone brown with a yellow undertone. It can be used as an accent inside or out and pairs well with warm whites such as Antique White U.S.A.®

colours.name: Elm Branch
colours.description: Elm Branch is a neutral and earthy tan with a slightly greenish undertone that is perfect for interiors and exteriors. Use Elm Branch with warm, soft whites and neutrals for an elegant look.

colours.name: Ceylon Tea
colours.description: Ceylon Tea is a warm brown with a red undertone that is great for feature walls inside or as features outside. It pairs well with the warmth of Antique White U.S.A.®, Natural White™ or Casper White Quarter.

colours.name: Army Issue
colours.description: Army Issue is a midtone warm neutral with a green undertone. It can be used as a feature or main wall colour inside or out. It pairs well with other whites and neutrals such as Antique White U.S.A.® and Handmade Linen Quarter.

colours.name: Dieskau
colours.description: Dieskau is a welcoming greige with a warm, slightly mauve undertone. Soft and subtle, Dieskau is perfect for any space inside the home and ideal if you're wanting to achieve the Hamptons look with trim in crisp white such as Lexicon® Half or Vivid White™. For exteriors, Dieskau can be used for walls or trims when using darker greige/greys. This tranquil colour also schemes beautifully with the warm dark grey of Klavier and warm mid-based greiges of Teahouse and Stepney.

colours.name: Silver Thaw
colours.description: The versatility, and often chameleon-like qualities, of grey makes it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Tranquil Retreat
colours.description: With a soft and subtle warmth, Tranquil Retreat is a great neutral to use inside or outside the home. It schemes beautifully with Terrace White, Namadji®, Teahouse and Colorbond® colours Woodland Grey®, Monument® and Shale Grey™.

colours.name: Ticking
colours.description: Dramatic and bold, Ticking is the perfect statement colour. A deep, cool toned grey that provides a chic and distinguished quality to contemporary interiors and will turn heads as a front door colour. Accompany Ticking's statement feel with cool whites and greys, such as Grey Pail.

colours.name: Water Worn
colours.description: Water Worn is a midtone grey with a slight blue undertone. It can be used as main wall or trim colour inside or out. It pairs well with both cool and warm whites as well as the muted creamy yellow of Jodhpurs Half.

colours.name: Vanessa Mae
colours.description: The versatility, and often chameleon-like qualities, of grey makes it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Tinker
colours.description: Tinker is a midtone cool grey with a blue undertone. It can be used as feature or main wall colour inside or out. It pairs well with the crisp brightness of Lexicon® and subtle grey of Miller Mood.

colours.name: Simone Weil
colours.description: The versatility, and often chameleon-like qualities, of grey makes it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Monk
colours.description: The versatility, and often chameleon-like qualities, of grey makes it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Meniscus
colours.description: The soft blue-grey of Meniscus makes it ideal for pairing with deeper greys such as Class Blue and crisp whites.

colours.name: Grid
colours.description: This deep charcoal grey with blue undertone, Grid is a wonderful choice for a main wall colour or trim inside or out. It pairs well with the cooler White on White™ and Vivid White™.

colours.name: Flooded Gum
colours.description: Flooded Gum is a beautiful warm greige that is perfect inside on main walls, accent walls and trim as well as a stunning option for exterior weatherboard and render surfaces. The softness of Flooded Gum pairs well with cool and neutral whites and charcoals.

colours.name: Babbler
colours.description: The versatility, and often chameleon-like qualities, of grey makes it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Domino
colours.description: Domino is a very popular dark charcoal with a subtle bluish undertone. Its versatility lends to use on outside projects and interiors such as formal rooms, theatre rooms and studios. It pairs perfectly with the cool undertone in Lexicon® Half and and the light grey Grey Pail.

colours.name: Aerobus
colours.description: Aerobus is a light grey with a blue undertone that can be used inside or out as trim or main wall colour. It pairs well with cool whites such as Vivid White™ and White on White™.

colours.name: Western Myall®
colours.description: The dark charcoal of Western Myall® with its slightly warm undertone makes it a great choice for theatre rooms, main bedrooms and exterior walls and trims. It pairs well with the warmth of Natural White™ and the cool crispness of Lexicon® Half.

colours.name: Tin Cat
colours.description: Tin Cat is a soft silver-grey with a mauve undertone that can be used as feature or main colour inside or out. It pairs well with cool Vivid White™ and warm Natural White™.

colours.name: Timeless Grey
colours.description: Timeless Grey is a great natural mid-tone grey that can be used as a main wall colour in light spaces or as an accent colour.  It goes well with softer greys such as Grey Pail or with warmers whites like Natural White™.  It is also a fabulous render or weatherboard colour that looks great with white or darker greys.

colours.name: Stepney
colours.description: Stepney is a versatile greige with a slightly warm undertone that works beautifully as a mid-tone greige for interiors. It can be used as either a main wall colour or as a feature inside with more subtle greiges such as Dieskau. Outside Stepney is perfect for weatherboards and render. Scheme with a crisp white such as Lexicon® Quarter for that Hamptons feel or for contrast with Grey Master.

colours.name: Moxa
colours.description: The versatility, and often chameleon-like qualities, of grey makes it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Miller Mood
colours.description: Miller Mood is a subtle cool lighter grey with a slight blue undertone. This wonderful soft colour can easily be used as a main colour inside or outside on weatherboards and render. It is perfect to use with white trims. Miller Mood looks great with crisp whites of Lexicon® Half and Lexicon® Quarter. For a deeper contrast try the modern cool grey of Signature or deep grey of Oolong.

colours.name: Marais
colours.description: The versatility, and often chameleon-like qualities, of grey makes it a great choice for almost every style of home from contemporary to traditional. From welcoming warm greys through to cooler shades, explore the depths of this colour to find the perfect combination for your space.

colours.name: Klavier
colours.description: A warm and intense dark grey, Klavier adds a welcoming element to contemporary homes. Enrich your spaces with this saturated grey to complement modern decor or as an accent shade or craft a bold exterior for a modern home. To accentuate this dramatic shade, pair with the warmth of White Exchange Half or soft and midtone greys such as Dieskau or Flooded Gum.

colours.name: Guild Grey
colours.description: A deep midtone grey with a subtle bluish undertone, it is a great addition for any interior either as a feature colour or for a bolder deep look on the exterior. Guild Grey pairs well with the cool light grey of Miller Mood and lush warm ivory of Whisper White.

colours.name: Musing
colours.description: Musing is a soft warm grey with a mauve undertone. It is ideal for use as a main wall colour inside and out. It pairs well with the slightly deeper grey of Strap and cool White on White™.

colours.name: Grey Pail
colours.description: Grey Pail is a soft and cloud-like natural grey with a slightly coolish undertone that can be used both inside and out. The neutral subtlety of Grey Pail looks great alongside so many colours from the greys and charcoals of Timeless Grey, Oolong, Ticking and Domino to the crisp white of Lexicon® Quarter.
